sections.title: Employment Contract
sections.text:
Jessica, Sniper Operator of Blacksteel, will provide effective attack power for the squad with her professional skills.

If only she wasn't such a scaredy-cat...

sections.title: Token
sections.text: A photo commemorating Jessica's entry into Blacksteel. It represents the start of a new life.

sections.title: Profile
sections.text: A fully enlisted Operator from Blacksteel, stationed at Rhodes Island as part of an exchange training program.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests on this Operator show clear outlines of internal organs, with no abnormal dark spots or shadows. No unusual traces of Originium particles present in the circulatory system, no signs of infection, confirming this operator as uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Jessica showed no symptoms of Oripathy.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.12u/L
Operator Jessica rarely comes into contact with Originium.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text: A panicky Operator dispatched from Blacksteel, Jessica is a reliable, combat-effective asset and full-time Blacksteel mercenary. But she suffers from such crippling insecurity that Vanilla, a Blacksteel apprentice, seems more dependable in battle.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text:
Perhaps thanks to her timidity, Blacksteel executives would often scoop Jessica up and subject her to tests of new equipment and devices. Even after arriving at Rhodes Island, Operators would ask Jessica to demonstrate their new equipment before they'd be willing to use it.
In a way, it shows how naturally trustworthy Jessica is.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text:
A part of Jessica's insecurity stems from selective perception.
In actuality, Jessica has the skills to hold at least the middle rank in an organization of any scale. In her time with Blacksteel as well as Rhodes Island, there has never been a blemish on her record.
